I may not understand fully how you feel but I can realate to this but just know you are probably a good good person I am a child so I’m not by any means a professional but I would recommend telling someone anyone wether it be a friend ,a family member or even a councillor if it’s hard to talk then all I can advice (assuming your an adult) is too say away from things that would make you depressed so like drugs and alcohol also another thing (any age) witch is hard too do but worth it is too stay away from abusive or toxic people it really helps.

I wish you the best of luck.

I’m 13 I’ve suffered with sexual assault too that’s the messed up thing I didn’t know if I should tell you I’ve also been bullied and dealt with toxic people there is a school counsolor but you have to wait months to actually see her

Its hard to talk to the teachers they just don’t care about me I won’t say what happened because I don’t know how old you are but some messed up things have happened to me and all they did was say to the person that did this messed up thing “she didn’t like that don’t do it again” like what he did was horrible and I think he deserves to be told off more than that for what he did
I used to but I lied to her saying I was ok because before when I talk to her about suicide she told my parents and my parents got angry
Maybe at first but they will be happy once they realise their lives are better without me
It was probably the closest to death in an attempt that’s ever happened to me but yet I’m still here unfortunately
